title: mikrotik_swos configuration file
description: Declarative configuration for a MikroTik SwOS/SwOS Lite switch, matching the keyword arguments accepted by the tofkamp/mikrotik_swos Python library (Mikrotik_System, Mikrotik_Port, Mikrotik_Vlans, Mikrotik_Snmp, Mikrotik_Poe, Mikrotik_Rstp, Mikrotik_Lacp, Mikrotik_Forwarding). A tool reading this file is expected to instantiate each tab class, call its configure/set method(s) with the matching section, then call save().

ports.description: Link tab. One entry per physical port (mikrotik_port.py / Mikrotik_Port.configure).

poe.description: PoE tab (mikrotik_poe.py / Mikrotik_Poe.configure_port). Only applicable to PoE-out capable switches.

rstp.description: RSTP tab, per-port enable (mikrotik_rstp.py / Mikrotik_Rstp.on_port). Bridge-wide RSTP settings live under system.

portIndex.description: 1-based port index. Valid range is 1..port_count as reported by the switch (link.b); this schema cannot enforce the device-specific upper bound.

device.description: Connection parameters used to construct each tab class, e.g. Mikrotik_Port(url, login, password). Not written to the switch itself.

url.description: Switch address, with or without scheme (e.g. '192.168.88.1' or 'http://192.168.88.1'). HTTPS is not supported by SwOS.

system.description: System tab, bridge-wide RSTP settings, IGMP snooping, DHCP snooping, discovery protocol (mikrotik_system.py / Mikrotik_System.set).

allow_from_net4.description: IPv4 network allowed to manage the switch, e.g. '10.0.0.0/8'. Parsed with ipaddress.IPv4Network(strict=False); a bare host address defaults to /32.

allow_from_vlan.description: VLAN ID allowed to manage the switch (0 = any/disabled, device dependent).

allow_from_port.description: Ports allowed to manage the switch.

igmp_fast_leave.description: Ports with IGMP fast leave enabled.

igmp_querier.description: Requires firmware >= 2.16 and igmp_snooping = true; otherwise ignored/forced off.

mikrotik_discovery_protocol.description: On firmware < 2.17 this is a single on/off switch (boolean). On firmware >= 2.17 it is a per-port list; 'true' expands to all ports, 'false' to none.

rstp_bridge_priority.description: RSTP bridge priority, hex string in [0, ffff] (e.g. '0x8000').

rsptp_forward_reserved_multicast.description: Forward reserved (802.1D) multicast addresses instead of processing them as BPDUs. Name matches the library's kwarg spelling exactly ('rsptp...').

snmp.description: SNMP tab (mikrotik_snmp.py / Mikrotik_Snmp.set). SwOS supports SNMP v1/v2c read-only; no traps, no config writes via SNMP.

port.description: Link tab entry for a single port (mikrotik_port.py / Mikrotik_Port.configure).

speed.description: Link speed in Mbps, only used when autoneg = false.

sfp_rate.description: SFP-only. Requires firmware >= 2.16. Setting this on a non-SFP port raises an error.

combo_mode.description: Combo-port-only. Requires firmware >= 2.16. Setting this on a non-combo port raises an error.

name.description: Defaults to the string form of vlan_id if omitted on create.

members.description: Ports that are members of this VLAN (mbr). Equivalent to repeated Mikrotik_Vlans.add_port() calls.

poePort.description: PoE tab entry (mikrotik_poe.py / Mikrotik_Poe.configure_port). port_id range is 1..port_poe_count, which is not always equal to port_count.

lldp_enabled.description: Only meaningful on switches that report LLDP support (has_lldp).

group_id.description: LAG group id. Only used/valid when mode = 'static'.

forwarding.description: Forwarding tab: per-port isolation table and per-port VLAN handling (mikrotik_port_isolation.py / Mikrotik_Forwarding).

port_isolation.description: For each port, which other ports it is allowed to forward to (Mikrotik_Forwarding.port_isolation). The port always excludes itself; any port not listed is isolated from this one.

allowed_ports.description: Either the literal string 'any' (no isolation) or an explicit list of port indices this port may forward to.

port_vlan.description: Per-port VLAN handling (Mikrotik_Forwarding.port_vlan_config). Any field omitted is left unchanged on the switch.

force_vlan_id.description: Force all traffic on this port into default_vlan_id.
